_readme: Curated roster notes (PRO-169): people whose tenure the page sweeps cannot date, each window taken from the person's own filings beside TCV's funds (Section 16 forms, first to last on EDGAR full text, sources/edgar/fts-hits.json) or the firm's own fund Form Ds, one basis line per person. Merged into partner-roster.json by scratch/roster-curate.py; aliases are the spellings the sweeps produce for the same person.
